title: Exceeded expectations!
text: This tour was the perfect way to discover the hidden gems of Barcelona!  Christian was so knowledgeable and engaging.  He was also super accommodating when we had a schedule mixup.  Worth the time and money - lovely way to enjoy the city.
author: juliebE2223LF

title: Tour with great places, history and personality
text: We were on Tuesday with Michael in Barcelona. It was impressive, informative and very entertaining. Michael showed us the city from another, very beautiful side. Away from tourist attractions and crowds of people. He showed us beautiful places to stay, with hints of great restaurants, eateries and small cafes. He walked with us through narrow streets with a lot of charm and naturalness and brought the history of the city to life in places such as the Roman city walls. author: annetth292

title: Insider’s view
text: The guide was very knowledgeable and had some excellent tips unrelated to the tour as well. I would not recommend this to a family with kids, but the adults in our group enjoyed.
author: Janine_H

title: Great guided tour with sympathetic guide
text:
We were both on the 2.5-hour Hidden Places tour with Michael today.
Was a lot of fun and was very informative.
We have seen many places where you were not crushed by the tourist flows.
Can we only recommend...
author: Thomas B

title: Interesting walking tour with very engaging guide.
text: Christian was extremely knowledgeable and shared so many interesting facts and stories about the city we would have never known. We loved walking with him around the beautiful and historic city!
author: Colleen_B

title: Very nice, competent and friendly. I really highly recommend it.
text: I am a city guide in Munich and booked the tour "Hidden Streets" with my family as an exclusive tour. Christian was our guide and showed us the city. Since we were in Barcelona for the first time, we naturally had a lot of questions. Christian explained everything to us and so we were able to explore many "not overrun" corners. He also gave us many tips. Very nice, competent and friendly. Can really highly recommend. @Christian - thank you very much
author: schwarzgold

title: Great way to start our Barcelona vacation!
text: Our multi-generational group of 13 had this private tour with Christian on our first full day in Barcelona. Fabulous way to start the vacation! Highly recommend at the beginning of your visit. We were able to go back and shop and dine in some hidden areas of the city that Christian showed us that we wouldn’t have found on our own. He had interesting information and stories to share. Thank you, Christian!
author: StephanieDMN

title: Very Insightful and Fun Tour
text:
My girlfriend and I did this private tour with Michael and had the best time!
We got a lot of knowledge about the different sights and sides of Barcelona, not just visiting the most famous places, but gaining a real understanding of what makes the city special and seeing all the little hidden alleys and hearing about the history of the city and how it developed. In addition to that, it was just very interesting to talk to Michael and hear about his life and his history with Barcelona. He also provided us with more tips for our visit and kept informing us about upcoming events.

title: Fantastic tour through the old town of Barcelona
text: We were a group of 4 friends and booked the tour with Christian right at the beginning of our vacation. We were all very excited about the stories and information we learned. It was really very interesting. Thank you very much Christian.
author: rogersennhauser

title: Off the beaten track is best!
text: Barcelona is enormous and it’s easy to get lost amongst the throngs of tourists. Christian took us through some amazing neighborhoods that we never would have discovered otherwise. As a result, I purchased a piece of jewelry from the studio of an amazing local artist and I am ecstatic!
author: 296queenj
